messages:
Priya: Heads-up: SilverCrest is seeing a recurring latency hump during their morning batch jobs (08:40-09:10 UTC). p95 tokens for their primary endpoint climbed ~300ms above baseline. Renewal check-in in 6 days, would like to propose a low-risk optimization.
Priya: Quick read: majority non-streaming completions, median prompt ~210 tokens, responses ~140 tokens, occasional bursts of parallel requests from their marketing pipeline.
Sam: Do we have traces? Any memory pressure or OOMs?
Tobias: I pulled traces, no OOMs but GPU queue latency spikes when batch size jumps >6. Looks like continuous batching latency cliff.
Priya: Proposed steps: 1) enable int8 quant profile on their dedicated pool for a canary, 2) route 10% of traffic to redwood/latency-lite-v1, 3) add hosted fallback for safety (10% hosted).
Priya: Canary plan outline: 10% -> 25% over 90min if p95 and error_rate stable. Rollback on any semantic regression or p95 > baseline + 200ms for 10m.
Eve (SilverCrest): Thanks, Priya. Concern: will compact model change output for our templated summaries? We need output parity for compliance.
Sam: Good call. We'll run a 12-item eval suite (customer copy templates) and diff rouge/bert scores before promoting. Also run a small human spot check.
Tobias: Ops notes: reduce continuous_batch_size_limit for SilverCrest pool from 72 -> 48 during canary window. Pre-warm kv cache with top-20 prefixes to avoid thrash.
Priya: Snippet for route config I'm proposing:
```
route: silvercrest-quick-canary
- match: customer_id == "silvercrest"
- weight: 10
- model: redwood/latency-lite-v1:int8
- pool: dedicated-silver-01
- fallback: hosted
- autoscale_headroom: 0.2
- continuous_batch_size_limit: 48
```
Sam: I'll add a regression job: `python infra/evals/run_eval.py --customer silvercrest --model redwood/latency-lite-v1:int8 --samples evalset_silvercrest.json` and report diffs.
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: silvercrest-canary-4345678901; monitor: p95_tokens, error_rate, semantic_coverage. Auto-revert rule configured: if p95 > baseline+200ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.8% for 5m -> revert route to redwood/full-v1.
Tobias: I'll allocate +1 GPU to dedicated-silver-01 for the first 3 hours of the canary and watch queue latency. Also enabling KV-prefetch TTL=75s.
Eve (SilverCrest): 16:30 UTC works for a quick call to sign-off on eval set and rollback thresholds. Please include our QA lead.
Priya: Scheduling invite now for 16:30 UTC, will attach eval samples.
Sam: One more: add a lightweight A/B diff capture in prod logs to surface any output tokenization or punctuation shifts. Keep retention 7 days for the canary.
Priya: Agreed. Action items: Priya prepare evalset + invite, Sam run regression and A/B capture, Tobias change pool limits + provision GPU, ops-bot monitor + auto-revert.
Eve (SilverCrest): Appreciate the proactive runbook. If this reduces latency and passes evals we're open to a gradual long-term model migration.
Priya: Great. Will post canary start + interim metrics here once live. :sparkles:
